  • Overlooking Service Access: Choose video walls with easy maintenance access to minimize downtime.
  • Missing Regulatory Requirements: Stay updated on industry standards and local codes for electrical and structural compliance.

Future Trends in LED Video Wall Technology

The LED display industry continues to advance at a rapid pace. Emerging trends shaping Houston installations include:

  • Mini/MicroLED: Increasing pixel density for sharper, more vibrant visuals and ultra-fine detailing.

For most retail applications, a pixel pitch between 1.5mm and 2.5mm offers crisp visuals even at close range. Let us help determine the right option for your environment.

Routine dusting and periodic hardware checks keep your display running optimally. Our modular panels also allow for fast repairs if necessary.
